headline: Traded all day: TPG reported before Thursday's open and rose 7.4% on double volume; tonight's items are summaries
reasoning: Sources: TPG's Q3 2026 results and call, summarized tonight (TradingView/Quartr; Moomoo): 'net income of $0.41 per diluted share and announced a reduction in its quarterly dividend to $0.55 per share'; 'raised its fiscal year 2026 fundraising guidance to exceed $55 billion ... dry powder hitting a record $86 billion'.

The results were public before Thursday's session: TPG opened 45.58 (+2.1% vs 44.63), closed 47.94 (+7.4%) on 371,105 shares, 1.9x the prior day. Benzinga carried no results line during the day, so the feed missed the release itself and tonight's summaries look new.
After hours: no IEX trades. A fundraising target is not earnings guidance, and the dividend cut cuts the other way.
objections: Priced by a full session; mixed (fundraising up, dividend down).
